dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraphs of graphs with large chromatic number. VI. Banana tre…
dossier_meta.statement_text: Which multigraphs $H$ have the property that for all $\kappa$ there exists $c$ such that every $H$-subdivision-free graph with clique number at most $\kappa$ has chromatic number at most $c$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper poses two bullet-point questions about characterising multigraphs $H$ by a pervasiveness-type condition. For the second (stronger) question, which involves all subdivisions of $H$, the answer is known for controlled classes; the first question, which asks about $H$-subdivision-free graphs directly, is explicitly stated to remain open.
